_comment: The canonical line items behind every budget category.
SOURCE for the Details tab. Edit here, re-push, and the Budget tab's Plan
Amounts are ₦/month. tier: Fixed | Committed | Discretionary.
payday: A = the 70% landing at the END of the PREVIOUS calendar month.
It funds the 1st-14th. ~₦971,416 at the August mix.
B = the 30% landing ~the 14th (always last month's remainder).
It funds the 15th-month end. ~₦416,325 at the August mix.
Baseline given 2026-08-26. Revised same day by Samuel for September.
_plan_start_note: plan_start = the first month the Plan column actually describes.
The baseline was set 2026-08-26 FOR September, so August was never planned.
The Budget tab greys every month before this and excludes them from vs-plan,
so an unplanned month can never read as an overspend.
tracking_start = the date Setup!B5 (the opening bank balance) was taken.
Everything earned or spent BEFORE it is already inside that balance, so it
must never also appear on Income/Expenses — that would double-count and
recurring: money.md Rule 4: paid in full before any discretionary line. August was ₦200,000 — a ₦300,000 shortfall, on the record.
MOVED to Payday A 2026-08-26. She needs it at the start of the month to buy essentials at home. This one does not flex to the back half.
MOVED to Payday B 2026-08-26 — he is paid mid-month, not at the start.
CUT 2026-09-02, his call: he edits on DaVinci Resolve now. Row kept, not deleted. ₦14,900/month, ₦44,700 by December, ₦178,800 a year.
KEPT. His words: helps his work, and his only entertainment.
CUT 2026-08-26. Row kept, not deleted — a cancelled sub that reappears is a pattern.
STARTS SEPTEMBER 2026. He is resuming the gym. Not a line to raid — it is the one that pays back.
SPLIT OUT 2026-09-02. Cleaning supplies bought with the front-half shop — hypo, bathing soap, washing soap.
The remainder of the ₦40,000 household line.

MOVED B → A on 2026-09-02. It is a stock-up shop, not a drip, and it has to happen in the front half or he does not eat until the 14th. His September list came to exactly ₦30,000 — milk, cornflakes, garri, groundnuts, oats, biscuits, coffee milk — so this line has no slack in it at all. See context/things-to-buy.md.
HELD at his request. Costs the December target ₦100,000 across four months.
SPLIT OUT 2026-09-02: ₦5,000 around the house, ₦5,000 to church on Sunday. THIS LINE EXISTS BECAUSE HE MISSED CHURCH ON 30 AUGUST for want of ₦5,000, while the whole transport budget sat on Payday B.
The remainder of the ₦20,000 transport line. 30,000 → 20,000 on 2026-08-26.

20,000 → 10,000 on 2026-08-26. His words: 'I am not giving to anyone, only when someone asks.' context/spirit.md records no tithe or giving commitment, so this is his call with nothing pulling against it.
SPLIT OUT 2026-09-02. September: haircut ₦3,000, floss ₦1,000, pen ₦1,000.
The remainder. 50,000 → 10,000 on 2026-08-26, his number, deeper than the 25,000 recommended.

ADDED 2026-09-02, planned at ₦0 DELIBERATELY. ₦584 of charges left the account on the first payday — ₦250 visible inside the Cowrywise transfer, ₦334 he could not attribute at all. His words: 'Charges where dedcuted at random during different transfers, I couldn't keep track of them indiviudally.' It is real, recurring money with no line, which is precisely the thing this budget exists to stop. It accrues actuals against a zero plan so that at month end there is a true figure to set it to, rather than a guess.

OPENED 2026-09-03. A LIVE CATEGORY WITH A ₦0 PLAN, on purpose — not a cancelled line. The 3 Sep shop was ₦51,150 across feeding, household and personal; Samuel gave a total and an item list but no per-item amounts ("I can't say it all"), so it was NOT split rather than invent numbers into the record (money.md Rule 6). The Budget tab will therefore show ₦51,150 spent against ₦0 planned until the split is done. THAT IS THE FINDING, NOT A BUG. Allocate it across Feeding / Chores / Personal at the next planning session and retire this line to inactive.

2026-09: CORRECTED 2026-09-02 from ₦50,000 — she confirmed the school needs ₦100,000 and she herself needs ₦50,000. September's girlfriend spend is ₦150,000 either way; only the split moved. DUE BEFORE THE 14th, confirmed, so it stays on Payday A. OPEN: school fees are usually termly. If this repeats it is a LINE, not a surprise — ask before October.

She needs ₦50,000 this month, not ₦100,000 — her own confirmation, 2026-09-02. Booked as a reduction against the recurring line so the ₦100,000 baseline still stands for October. OPEN: is ₦50,000 the new normal, or September only?

Samuel spoke to his dad on 2026-09-02 and his dad agreed to skip this month. SEPTEMBER ONLY — the ₦100,000 recurring line stands from October. This one decision is what turned September from ₦41,973 underwater into ₦58,027 free, and it is the only lever in the month that depended on someone else saying yes.
NEW 2026-09-02. On top of the ₦30,000 membership. Buys the morning-movement habit, 6× a week — the one line on this budget that pays him back.

RAISED from ₦50,000 on 2026-09-02. His words: he has no idea what the trip, hotel, feeding and transport will cost, and he has not travelled in a while. STILL A GUESS. Any overrun comes from the Buffer — never Goal 1, never the building fund. Bring back the real number; October plans off truth, not off this.
He owes her ₦90,000. This pays ₦40,000. ₦50,000 REMAINS OUTSTANDING WITH NO DATE. money.md still says 'Loans — all cleared'; that is now wrong.
Samuel, 2026-09-16: the creator is not available and he has no time. SEPTEMBER ONLY — the N25,000 line returns in October.
Samuel, 2026-09-16: 'holding on community admin payment for now, as the admin is doing a free work right now.' OPEN: is anything owed later, and does October pay?
Samuel, 2026-09-16: 'No giving for now.' OPEN: does October's N10,000 stand?
ADDED 2026-09-16, his number. Payday B had no food line and he was already buying meals (chicken N3,500 on 15 Sep counts against it).

_savings_note: Per-month plan, not a flat average. Goal 1 is LOWER in September because
September carries ₦140,000 of one-offs the other months do not. A flat
₦249,124/month asked for money September does not have, and a plan that asks
for money you do not have gets paid out of the building fund or the buffer.
bills + one-offs + every pot = income, exactly, every month Sep-Dec.
The Budget tab proves it in THE MONTH MUST BALANCE.
account = where the money physically goes. A pot with no account is a pot
that cannot be funded on payday.

savings.note: THE December number. ₦1,004,164 across four months + the ₦3,503 opening = ₦1,007,667. September is lower because its ₦140,000 of one-offs come first. Moves on Payday B — Samuel's call 2026-08-26, because Payday A is always full. ACCOUNT PICKED 2026-09-02, confirmed by Samuel at the reckoning: it is a Cowrywise account, opened at the budget session, separate from the Buffer's Emergency account. THE NAME CLASH IS NOW REAL AND IT IS THE SECOND ONE ON THIS SHEET: Goal 1 and the ring-fenced Cowrywise investment sit on the same platform, and money.md Rule 7 says the investment never counts toward the ₦1M. Two pots, one platform, one balance that has to be read apart by hand. Same shape as the Buffer/Emergency clash below. Resolve before December, when the ₦1M is scored.
RING-FENCED, Rule 7. Never pauses, never counts toward the ₦1M or the ₦3M. ₦305,000 already in. STOPS after December — it moves into actual stocks Jan 2027, which frees ₦100,000/month from January.

Lives in the savings account he already has, called Emergency — his answer 2026-08-28. NOTE THE NAME CLASH: that account holds the BUFFER from Sep to Dec, not the emergency fund, which does not start until Jan 2027. From January two different pots would share one account and the balance stops meaning anything. Decide before then. The cushion urgencies come out of, so savings stop being the valve — the direct fix for the ₦595,250 that evaporated June–August. Also fed by month-end underspend and by any 4-video month's excess.
Starts Jan 2027, after Goal 1 closes. ON TOP of the ₦1M — ₦4,000,000 total.
Starts Jan 2027. Does not compete with December. SHARES AN ACCOUNT WITH THE BUFFER — see the Buffer note.

lean_month_ladder: Decided in advance so it is not negotiated at 11pm on a short month.
5. ONLY THEN a conversation. Savings are never the valve (Rule 1).
